description: Germany only. German employment law, Germany only: annual leave entitlement (Urlaubsanspruch, BUrlG) in working days, split into statutory minimum (gesetzlicher Mindesturlaub) and contractual extra leave (Mehrurlaub). Handles part-time (Teilzeit), alternating weeks, a change of working days during the year, entry or exit during the year (Teilurlaub) and extra leave for severe disability (§ 208 SGB IX). Use it when someone asks how many leave days an employee has.

arbeitstage_pro_woche.description: Days with work per week, each day counts fully however short; average for alternating weeks, e.g. 2.5

austritt.description: Last day of employment if in the year, optional (YYYY-MM-DD)

bezugswoche.description: Reference week of the contract: 5_tage (working days) or 6_tage (Werktage). Default 5_tage

eintritt.description: Entry date if in or after the start of the year, optional (YYYY-MM-DD)

jahr.description: Leave year, default the current year

jahresurlaub.description: Annual leave in the contract for full time, in days of the reference week

mehrurlaub.description: Contract rule for extra leave on entry or exit in the year: wie-gesetz (contract says nothing, follows the law) or anteilig (contract cuts it pro rata). Default wie-gesetz

schwerbehindert.description: Recognised severe disability (GdB from 50), not equal status

schwerbehindert_ab.description: Recognised only from this date in the year, optional (YYYY-MM-DD)

wechsel_ab.description: Day the number of working days changes, optional (YYYY-MM-DD)

wechsel_tage.description: Working days per week from wechsel_ab
